description: This Java class defines a MonkeyEventQueue which extends LinkedList to manage MonkeyEvent objects, including handling throttling logic with optional randomization.

classes.name: MonkeyEventQueue
classes.description: A specialized queue for managing MonkeyEvent instances, with added support for throttling and randomization.

methods.name: MonkeyEventQueue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the queue with a Random object, throttle duration, and randomization flag.

methods.name: addLast
methods.description: Overrides LinkedList.addLast to add a MonkeyEvent and, if throttlable, adds a MonkeyThrottleEvent with computed throttle delay.
